q: Weyl's equidistribution theorem for the sequence (nα mod 1) with irrational α follows ergodically from:
opts: The law of large numbers applied to random sequences
Birkhoff's theorem for the uniquely ergodic rotation R_α (Lebesgue is the unique invariant measure, so time averages = space averages for ALL starting points)
exp: The rotation R_α: x↦x+α mod 1 with irrational α is uniquely ergodic (Lebesgue is the unique invariant measure). Birkhoff's theorem for uniquely ergodic systems gives convergence for all starting points, not just a.e. — this is exactly equidistribution.
